tests.name: Day suppresses all meteors even when meteor weather is requested
Tornado and seven colour rainbow grow softly and use actual radial anchors
Both initial garden and globe cameras include a readable rainbow crown
Heavy storm has finite streaks and impacts only below the real waterline
Night shower contains several concurrent streaks and remains bounded for 80 seconds
A paused frame cannot advance simulation, append meteors or mutate particle data
Planet selection suspends all effect timing and restores the exact meteor frame
Weather exit fades continuously instead of disappearing immediately
Phone and reduced motion profiles use lower bounded particle pools
Dispose owns its resources only, detaches both roots and is idempotent
